title: W417 for a re-applied insertion placed before its anchor line
notes: §12 item 20 (AMBIGUITIES R15): 'the applied pattern also matches at the candidate position' is read with the applied pattern aligned on the anchor (tried one line before the candidate, where a previous application put the `+` line). Read literally (applied pattern starting at the candidate) the re-applied insertion-before (§2.3) would never be detected.
